featured_reviews.name: Prajakta Bhawsar
featured_reviews.review_text: I’ve been visiting this store since childhood, and after returning again after 3–4 years, the change is disappointing. The shelves and products are dusty, the store is half-empty, and what was once a vibrant space now feels like it’s operating merely out of obligation. Most products don’t have price tags, leaving customers vulnerable to being overcharged at the counter. If you’re unlucky enough to catch a billing error, the response is far from reassuring. On closer inspection, several items are billed higher than they should be. What was once a trusted store now feels like a loot fest, a truly sad decline.

featured_reviews.name: Sekar P
featured_reviews.review_text: Good collection of all provisions, fruits and veggies. But the price is slightly high.

featured_reviews.name: Pravin Sadaphule
featured_reviews.review_text:
Its a supermarket situated at sion panvek highway behind maitri park st stand.  Its spread across 3000 sqfeet area next to kaya clinic.

Outside of shop they sell vegtables, keep their refrigraters for dairy product and baggage counter. Inside they have all sort of indian groceries, masales, process food, bathroom and kitchen products, baby products, godrej poultry and many more.

Being situated at one of the posh location of mumbai they are not prize competitive. They are expesive. Good thing about them is even if they are departmental store and involved mostly in cash trasaction they have opt for pvt ltd registration which means they comoly audit and pay taxes.

featured_reviews.name: nimesh kumar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Surprise to see a fixed rate departmental store in today's era where you can easily get items with discounts without stepping out from your residence...
Though it has a wide variety of items in its catalogue but selling it at a mrp is a concern for me.....
This place also doesn't have a parking space so adds a bit of discomfort to visit there....
To conclude it would be a better place if they introduce some excited offers

featured_reviews.name: Nasreen Rustomfram
featured_reviews.review_text:

Crowded and small space for movement.
Sales staff needs better training. They stand around and are not always useful.
They need to replenish items such as cut vegetables and coconut chutney which gets over by 3 or 4 pm.

featured_reviews.review_text: Whole range of grocery items available here. Many brands stock with latest manufacturing dates ensure quality of products. Shopping here is always joyful experience. featured_reviews.name: Pradeep Shenoy
featured_reviews.review_text:
Reasonable prices as you expect from any DMart. Large store spread over two floors with wide range of products including shoes and clothing.
The best part is availability of free parking at the basement. This is the biggest plus for this outlet as hardly any other supermarket offers parking space, free or paid.

featured_reviews.name: Farheen Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
“At M Mart, Chembur, the exit staff misbehaved with me. I was with my family, and I had my small daughter with me who was crying due to the heavy crowd inside. At the billing counter, staff asked one person to stay while the rest of the family was asked to move outside.
I was taking my daughter outside because she was crying, when the exit staff stopped me and asked for the bill. I explained that my daughter was crying and my family was still inside, and I requested them to let me step out temporarily.
However, they did not allow me to exit and kept repeatedly asking for the bill, even though I was not carrying any shopping bag or items in my hands. Despite explaining the situation, they refused to let me go.
This incident happened around 8:00 PM. It is confusing because hand bags are not allowed inside and I was empty handed.

featured_reviews.name: Sandeep Chopde
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve been shopping at Nature’s Basket, Chembur regularly and it’s easily one of the best premium grocery stores in the area. The quality of their products is consistently excellent — from fresh meats to exotic vegetables and imported essentials, everything is very well stocked and maintained.

A special mention to Reena, who is always extremely helpful with general groceries and makes the overall shopping experience smooth and pleasant. Also, if you enjoy wines and international beers, their collection is genuinely impressive. Vikas, who manages the wine section, is knowledgeable, courteous, and always gives great recommendations.

The staff here really elevate the experience with their professionalism and personal attention. Highly recommended for anyone looking for quality groceries and a premium shopping experience in Chembur.

featured_reviews.name: Prakash Lalwani
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’m extremely disappointed with my recent experience at this store. I purchased what I assumed were fresh grocery items from a well-known, branded outlet, only to later discover that one of the products had already expired. This is completely unacceptable, especially from a store that claims to maintain high quality and safety standards.

Selling expired products is not just careless—it’s potentially harmful to customers’ health. It raises serious concerns about how inventory is managed and whether proper checks are being conducted on a regular basis.

I trusted this store because of its brand reputation, but this incident has shaken that trust. I strongly urge the management to take immediate corrective action, improve their quality control processes, and ensure that no other customer has to go through such a risky and disappointing experience.

Until then, I would advise others to double-check expiry dates before purchasing anything from here.

featured_reviews.name: Anoushka Sud
featured_reviews.review_text:
Unlike last time, the in-store experience was much better. I think the store staff has taken my feedback constructively and positively and have therefore improved leaps and bounds over a period of time. Completely satisfied and happy.
Best wishes:)

featured_reviews.review_text:
Store Staff at the billing counter as well as assistants in the stores have super attitude. Don't know why. The lady at billing counter is always frustrated.  Keeps throwing stuff from the basket while billing. I have never seen a smile on her face to date. People at the billing counter should keep their attitude,

featured_reviews.name: Hemant Sahasrabudhe
featured_reviews.review_text:
It is a full fledged grocery store.

Full marks to the management making most of the available space - literally every nook and corner of the shop.

Off course most of the similar shops in the vicinity religiously follow the same practice. 😄

They also seem to be experimenting with possible avenues for different products... say for example BudWeiser Non-alcoholic beverages!!

Overall you feel welcomed when you visit the shop.

featured_reviews.name: Mithila Nanal
featured_reviews.review_text: One of the best super markets in Tilak Nagar. They have a variety of products and good quantity. Be careful with the expiry date on all products, sometimes products are too old. Also the shop is too congested. Only one person can walk in between the closely placed stacks.

featured_reviews.name: rakhi more
featured_reviews.review_text: Get most of the daily requirement things under one roof. Home delivery system available. Fair prices. Their own brand groceries is reasonable & good quality

featured_reviews.name: Shashwat Khare
featured_reviews.review_text:
Its a nice & air-conditioned marketplace which houses staple foods, coldribks, groceries, cosmetics, hygiene items, cookies etc.

Also they have partenered with m-paani app for loyalty points rewards. I have redeemed the points and got discounts on my bill. The service is quick. They have a small section of fresh vegetables & fruits displayed outside.
Only gripe is that the discounts are comparatively lesser compared to e commerce websites like Amazon pantry & Big basket.

featured_reviews.name: Manish Mohan Jacob
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ideal Shopping destination for your grocery needs at a discounted/affordable rates.

Flipside: Space Constraints and Shop not well equipped with Aircon not flowing in all corners.
